# thesupersuperanime.lol

> A personal anime streaming site with a full episode library, community features, AniList sync, and a global leaderboard.

## What this site does
- Stream anime episodes with sub and dub support via HLS
- Track watch history and per-episode progress
- Episode-level comments and community discussion
- Watchlist management with AniList OAuth sync (import/export)
- Genre browsing with community voting on genre accuracy
- Global leaderboard ranked by minutes watched
- Public user profiles
- Issues and suggestions board
- Admin announcement system (site-wide banners)
- Skip intro/outro support (powered by AniSkip)

## Authentication
- Discord OAuth or email verification
- Anonymous browsing supported when site is in open mode
- Authentication required for comments, watchlist, leaderboard, and voting

## Key pages
- / — Home feed with trending, seasonal, airing, and upcoming anime
- /search — Search and filter by title, genre, format, status, season, year
- /anime/[id] — Anime detail page with paginated episode grid
- /watch/[animeId]/[episodeNum] — Episode watch page with comments
- /leaderboard — Global watch time leaderboard with podium
- /genres — Browse anime by genre with community voting
- /genres/[genre] — Anime filtered by specific genre
- /user/[username] — Public user profiles
- /issues — Community issues and suggestions board
- /account — Account settings, AniList connection, watchlist

## Technical
- Metadata sourced from AniList GraphQL API
- Streams sourced from Anivexa API (anikoto, anineko providers)
- Sub and dub audio types with automatic deduplication
- HLS adaptive bitrate streaming
- Subtitles via VTT tracks when available

## Legal
- /privacy — Privacy policy
- /terms — Terms of service
